observations.statement: Each Build & Decode arena was physically checked and is fully enclosed by minecraft:barrier; flight cannot pass from one arena to another.
observations.invalidatedClaim: Players can fly out of their assigned arena during active gameplay.

observations.statement: After rejected water bucket placement, water/waterlogged residue can remain visible only to the acting client.
Roommaster/admin can destroy protected arena geometry and can use privileged/manual entity-spawn paths.

systemLessons: Loading or authored analysis bounds are not physical collision bounds.
A protection implementation is not active protection until production registration/reachability is proven.
Natural spawning gamerules must be separated from manual, command, script and privileged spawn paths.
Client-predicted mutations require client/server representation reconciliation after cancellation.
